Reply_CacheProblem.description: A local cache or recording failure, independent of what the provider returned.

Reply_DecisionReading.description: Plain reading of a 510(k) decision code.

Reply_DeviceRecallHeader.description: Native medical device product recall header, independent of event grouping.

initiated.description: Native event_date_initiated, preserving the source day.

Reply_DeviceRecallNumber.description: Native FDA product recall number, Z-NNNN-YYYY or the older Z-NNNN-YY, independent of its event number.

x-enum-descriptions: Matching 510(k) records by FDA product code, from openFDA's count facet.

Reply_DiagnosticCandidate.description: A conflict is visible once without a selected name or card.

oneOf.description: Native PMA submission; supplements retain their own identity.

applicant.description: Native applicant; missing and empty remain distinct.

date_received.description: Native date_received; missing and empty remain distinct.

decision_code.description: Native decision_code; missing and empty remain distinct.

decision_date.description: Native decision_date; missing and empty remain distinct.

decision_description.description: Native decision_description; missing and empty remain distinct. Left out when openFDA's value is "Unknown" and decision_reading is present.

decision_reading.description: BioMCP's reading of a decision_code whose openFDA description does not name it, such as de-novo-granted for DENG; absent otherwise.

device_name.description: Native device_name; missing and empty remain distinct.

k_number.description: Exact native K or De Novo DEN number.

product_code.description: Native product_code; missing and empty remain distinct.

oneOf.description: One native product recall record; repeated event numbers remain separate records.

classification.description: Classification from an exact enforcement recall_number match, absent without that match.

product_description.description: Native product_description of the recall record; a device name search matches this text.

reason.description: Native reason_for_recall of the recall record.

oneOf.description: One matched WHO product with cells from its first matching native row.

prequalification_year.description: Unmodified prequalification year cell from the same row.

matched.description: Complete native relation that matched the source selector.

name_match.description: How `--name` matched the test name; absent without `--name`.

oneOf.description: A native relation remains visible without a current card.

id.description: Exact relation-owned test accession and version.

matched.description: The original matched relation; no manufactured header.

oneOf.description: Several incompatible native rows with the same exact accession/version.

name_match.description: How `--name` matched any conflicting row's test name; absent without `--name`.

problem.description: Explicit source identity problem; no chosen winner.

Reply_DiagnosticCountUnit.description: Meaning of the envelope's total for a source-owned diagnostic page.

Reply_DiagnosticDeviceId.description: Source device identifier; DEN and H identifiers imply no executable get.

Reply_DiagnosticLaboratory.description: Compact native laboratory context without authorization interpretation.

name.description: Source laboratory name, absent when the native cell is empty.

Reply_DiagnosticPage.description: Source-ordered native diagnostic and medical-device submission candidates.

count_unit.description: Exact meaning of the envelope total; supplied by the owning source command.

distinct_id_total.description: Distinct complete native IDs across the selected relation collection.

items.description: Complete source-owned rows in native order; envelope totals count native rows.

product_code_counts.description: 510(k) records by product code; present only when `--aggregate product-code` was asked.

source_query.description: Exact openFDA search expression sent for a PMA, 510(k) or device recall page; it names the field each filter matched.

Reply_DiagnosticPmaHeader.description: Compact exact PMA row identity; its native empty base cell is explicit.

applicant.description: Native applicant when supplied, including explicit empty.

decision_code.description: Native decision_code when supplied, including explicit empty.

decision_date.description: Native decision_date when supplied, including explicit empty.

supplement_number.description: Absent differs from explicit empty base cell.

trade_name.description: Native trade_name when supplied, including explicit empty.

Reply_DiagnosticProductCodeCount.description: One FDA product code and the matching 510(k) records filed under it.

count.description: Matching 510(k) records with this product code.

Reply_DiagnosticProductCodeCounts.description: Matching 510(k) records counted by product code with openFDA's count facet (1019).

items.description: Product codes in openFDA's order, most records first.

limit_reached.description:
openFDA returned its most codes for one count, 1,000; more codes may exist. A narrower
decision-date range lists every code.

sum.description: Sum of the listed counts and the records without a product code.

sum_matches_total.description: The sum equals the page total, so every matching record is counted under a listed code.

without_product_code.description: Matching records openFDA counts under an empty product code; omitted when none.

Reply_DiagnosticSearch.description: Search five source records by default. FDA device recalls cover every medical device and show class; totals count recall records, without harm inference.

aggregate.description:
Count by product code.
Also counts every matching record by FDA product code, up to openFDA's 1,000 codes, and says whether the counts sum to the total; fda-510k only, first page.

biomarker.description:
Biomarker name in a cell.
Whole name in the individual table's biomarker cell, any case, surrounding spaces ignored: PIK3CA matches "PIK3CA, AKT1, and PTEN", not PIK3CA2. The group table is not searched; problems name it as filter.unsupported.

bundle_revision.description:
Stored bundle revision.
Immutable stored bundle revision retained by a continuation.

classification.description:
FDA recall class.
Native enforcement classification; FDA device recalls only. Selects enforcement records, which carry no product code.

classification_name.description:
FDA classification name phrase.
Phrase in openFDA's 510(k) openfda.device_name, FDA's name for the product code's device type, not the submitted device_name --name matches; 510(k) only.

condition.description:
Condition name text.
Text in GTR condition_identifiers, the test's condition names, matched like the GTR --name.

condition_id.description:
Exact MedGen:CUI.
Exact MedGen:CUI identifier only; with a gene, tests that list both.

date_from.description:
First row date, YYYY-MM-DD.
Inclusive newest date in an FDA companion row's device cell; fda-cdx only. Undated rows are left out and named in problems.

date_to.description:
Last row date, YYYY-MM-DD.
Inclusive newest date in an FDA companion row's device cell; fda-cdx only.

decision_from.description:
First date, YYYY-MM-DD.
Inclusive native decision date, YYYY-MM-DD; PMA and 510(k) only.

decision_to.description:
Last date, YYYY-MM-DD.
Inclusive native decision date, YYYY-MM-DD; PMA and 510(k) only.

device_id.description:
PMA or K identifier.
Exact PMA application, application/supplement or native K identity.

drug_application.description:
NDA/BLA application.
Cell-owned typed NDA/BLA application.

firm.description:
Recall firm phrase.
The drug recall search's name for --manufacturer on FDA device recalls: the same recalling_firm phrase; fda-device-recall only.

gene.description:
Exact gene symbol.
Exact source gene_symbol field, without alias expansion.

gene_id.description:
Exact NCBI GeneID.
Exact source GeneID, exclusive with gene symbol.

initiated_from.description:
First date, YYYY-MM-DD.
Inclusive initiation date, YYYY-MM-DD; FDA device recalls only.

initiated_to.description:
Last date, YYYY-MM-DD.
Inclusive initiation date, YYYY-MM-DD; FDA device recalls only.

intended_use.description:
Intended-use phrase.
Phrase in FDA PMA ao_statement, the approval order's intended use; PMA only, as openFDA 510(k) has no intended-use text.

limit.description: Five results by default; at most fifty source rows or product headers.

manufacturer.description:
Manufacturer phrase.
WHO manufacturer words, native FDA applicant (PMA/510(k)) or recalling_firm phrase.

marker.description:
WHO marker phrase.
Literal whole-word phrase in WHO's Pathogen/Disease/Marker cell. WHO rows carry prequalification_year.

name.description:
Native test or device name.
Phrase in PMA trade_name, 510(k) device_name or recall product_description; text in GTR lab_test_name, ignoring letter case; hyphens and spaces in your text are optional.

prequalified_from.description:
WHO IVD year.
First prequalification year included, YYYY; WHO publishes only the year.

prequalified_to.description:
WHO IVD year.
Last prequalification year included, YYYY; WHO publishes only the year.

product_code.description:
FDA product code.
Exact native FDA product code; PMA, 510(k) and device recalls only.

sort.description:
Row order.
Newest row date first over all matching rows, not one page; fda-cdx only. Without it rows keep FDA's order.

source.description:
Native diagnostic source.
Explicit native GTR, WHO IVD, FDA PMA, 510(k), companion or medical device recall discovery.

type.description:
Native test_type.
Exact native test_type value.

Reply_DiagnosticSort.description: FDA companion-table row order over every matching row of the stored snapshot.

Reply_DrugRecallClassification.description: FDA's native recall classification, with no local ranking.

Reply_FdaDrugApplication.description: Cell-owned drug application preserving native NDA/BLA prefix and leading zeros.

Reply_GeneSymbol.description: Source spelling of a gene symbol, with ASCII case-insensitive identity.

Reply_GtrConditionReference.description: A checked native MedGen target with independently optional source label.

id.description: Native MedGen identity from the condition relation.

Reply_GtrConditionRelation.description: Native condition membership; SNOMED cells never become GeneID.

condition.description: Shared MedGen concept with source label.

snomed_ct_id.description: Native SNOMED CT cell, including empty; never a gene ID.

Reply_GtrGeneReference.description: Independently retained native gene target fields; mapping requires at least one usable key.

label.description: Source gene symbol, absent when only the source GeneID survives.

ncbi_gene_id.description: Native GeneID from a gene relation, never a condition's SNOMED field.

Reply_GtrGeneRelation.description: Native gene relation; its numeric ID comes only from the gene row.

gene.description: Shared source-given GeneID and gene_symbol; absent GeneID stays absent.

native_gene_or_snomed_ct_id.description: Uninterpreted nonempty `gene_or_SNOMED_CT_ID` when it is not a checked NCBI Gene ID.

native_medgen.description: Independent native MedGen identity from GTR_identifier.

Reply_GtrHeader.description: Small resolved GTR candidate; broad gene and condition arrays stay off the header.

gene_count.description: Distinct symbols in the native genes cell: 1 is a single-gene test, hundreds an exome-scale one.

method_categories.description: Native method categories in source order, such as deletion/duplication analysis.

name.description: Native test name, absent when the cell is empty.

specimens.description: Specimen types in source order from GTR's XML release `gtr_ftp.xml.gz`, for this exact accession and version; absent when it lists none.

Reply_GtrMethod.description: One entry from one independent native method list.

list.description: Independent source list; lists are never positionally paired.

Reply_GtrNameMatch.description: How `--name` text sits in a GTR test name, ignoring letter case; hyphens and spaces in your text are optional; whole-word rows come first.

Reply_GtrTestId.description: Complete native GTR accession and positive version.

Reply_GtrTestRelation.description: Source-owned native membership or one independent method-list entry.

Reply_GtrTestType.description: Native GTR relation test category, not an offering or authorization judgment.

Reply_Incomplete.description: One thing a `partial` reply is missing, pointing at the detail already in the reply.

at.description: JSON pointer into this reply, such as `/sources/1` or a record's field.

code.description: The refused record's own problem code, when a problem is the cause.

reason.description: Why, when a typed source reason is known.

source.description: The source whose data is missing.

Reply_NcbiGeneId.description: A positive NCBI Gene identifier in canonical decimal text.

Reply_PageInfo.description: Search counts after filtering and deduplication.

total.description: Total matches: the source's own count when one source states more than the snapshot holds, otherwise the identities held by this snapshot.

truncated.description: Matching source count exceeded the retrieved window.

Reply_PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Reply_PmaNumber.description: Native FDA PMA base application number.

Reply_PmaSupplementCell.description: Native PMA supplement cell; empty denotes base and never becomes S000.

Reply_PoolInfo.description: Fixed lifetime and size of a stored search snapshot.

created.description: Publication wall time in Unix seconds.

expires.description: Fixed expiry wall time in Unix seconds.

Reply_Problem.description: A field that could not be accepted from a source record.

code.description: Why the field value was not accepted.

record.description:
The record's canonical identifier, when known. A `record.declined` problem has none, so
it names the record by a source key, such as `event_id:100178`.

source.description: The source that supplied the record.

Reply_ProblemCode.description: A stable code for a rejected field value.
x-enum-descriptions: The field value was not recognized.
Native collection exceeds the admitted complete source page.
A source repeats one exact identity with incompatible records.
A source record without a usable identity was left off the page; each problem names one such record.
The asked filter cannot read the records the field names, so they were not searched and may hold matches the page leaves out.

Reply_Reason.description: Why a source could not supply data.
x-enum-descriptions: The requested record was not found.
The public bucket does not hold an open text record.
Publisher response is not a PDF.
The local reader does not support the file or container format.
The response exceeds an explicit reader resource bound.
The source limited the request rate.
The local source quota refused admission without a network request.
Platform or configured certificate verification failed.
Connecting to or negotiating the configured proxy failed.
The reply could not be used.
The source data was being synchronized.
Identity lacks the identifier required to join this source.
The source document was read but does not state the value.

Reply_Source.description: A source of BioMCP data, identified by its canonical short name.
x-enum-descriptions: ChEMBL native records and carried component.
WHO Model List of Essential Medicines, from the WHO eEML.
MyChem DrugBank Open identity subset only.
openFDA FAERS drug adverse event reports.
Source-reported MedDRA reaction labels and versions.
NCBI Genetic Testing Registry public reports.
openFDA medical device product recall records.
Public cBioPortal with study-specific reuse terms.
Orphadata Science epidemiology and natural-history files.

Reply_SourceNotice.description: A source notice or request recovery step.

message.description: Why the names were expanded or retained.

names.description: Names actually searched; ambiguous identities retain the typed name only.

oneOf.description: Variant spellings and registry fields actually searched.

codon.description: Codon forms searched, which match trials written for any change at that position.

input.description: Whole caller-supplied variant or criteria text.

message.description: What was searched, where, and how to search the typed text only.

spellings.description: Spellings of the same change actually searched, including the typed text.

oneOf.description: Local request limits, source observations and recovery guidance.

data_date.description: Retained publisher dataset date, independent of acquisition and record events.

message.description: Reviewed guidance; any quoted provider wording remains source data.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds left before another source request may be admitted.

oneOf.description: Registered conditions lack the literal words requested in a condition search.

message.description: The source searches several fields and can expand terms; no expansion cause is inferred.

oneOf.description: A checked provider answer survived a local cache failure.

reason.description: Bounded local failure without paths or database diagnostics.

oneOf.description: The source still has graph pages after the bounded fetch window.

fallback.description: Default-source command offering another graph view.

oneOf.description: An empty LitVar lookup can be repeated with a caller-supplied rsID.

message.description: Guidance that never supplies or infers an rsID.

oneOf.description: PubMed supplied a named ESearch warning without changing its phrases.

name.description: Original provider warning name, including names added by PubMed later.

phrases.description: Original provider phrases, preserving whitespace and quotes.

oneOf.description: PubMed did not index these words.

Reply_SourceOutcome.description: One source's outcome with source notices and request guidance.

notices.description: Source notices and request recovery guidance.

use.description: Reviewed source use category; publisher terms remain authoritative: see `help sources`.

Reply_SourceState.description: State of a source actually asked by the command.

Reply_Step.description: A command argument list spelled from a typed action.

options.description:
Options this call also takes, each with a placeholder to fill in, such as
`"--decision-from": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"`; add any of them to `args`. MCP names them as tool
arguments. Absent when the step is only runnable as it is.

Reply_StepKind.description: Purpose of an available next command.

Reply_Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

Reply_Use.description: Reviewed source-use category, without inferring rights in individual records.

Reply_WhoProductId.description: WHO product listing identity, independent of product codes.

description:
One versioned command response; schema identity comes only from its body type.
JSON readers ignore unknown fields and unknown growable enum values within a major.

fields.description:
The row fields the caller chose with `--fields`, as given; absent without them.
Each row keeps those, its required keys and identifiers; other keys are left out.

incomplete.description: What a `partial` reply is missing; present only on `partial` replies.

local_error.description: Bounded local cache or recording failure, independent of provider outcomes.

page.description: Search page metadata. With zero results, `total` and `returned` are 0 and the result leaves out `items`, because replies omit empty lists.
